cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Help Me Keep This Quiet
cards.instruction: Get someone to help contain a secret without first revealing its full risk or purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the cupboard key till tomorrow. Don't tell your flatmate. You used to blurt out every surprise before I finished wrapping it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you tell me what's in the cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Better: you're asking before agreeing. You don't need the whole inventory. Nothing alive; will that do?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then collect it before she gets home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, a deadline. Text me when she leaves work, just 'key'. Remember how we got your messages down from three pages? One word this time.
